title: feat(plugin-security): delete the curated capability seeder — the boot writes no sys_capability row for the platform's capabilities (ADR-0131 D3, #15204 stage 6b-1b)
body:
Part of #15204
Clause-②: no

**Stage 6b-1b of the cutover plan only** (claim amendment 6098440046): the curated and derived-default capability seeder `bootstrapSystemCapabilities` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/bootstrap-system-capabilities.ts`) is deleted, with its test, its import and its one call in `security-plugin.ts`. This is a deletion only (batch #310 item 4). The rest of #15204 stays open. `bootstrapDeclaredCapabilities`, `capability-name-collision` and 6b-1a's transitional engine view are 6b-1c's and are kept as they are. No `sys_capability` row is deleted, `sys-capability.object.ts` is unchanged, and who may author a capability is unchanged (#22621 → A).

**Landing:** after stage 5 (C9), per stage-0 order correction 3. This PR stays a draft until the PM schedules it.

## Premise, re-verified on `origin/main` `96469912`

- The seeder is still on `main`: 995 lines, plus a 1,376-line test. Its only production caller is `security-plugin.ts` (import `:88`, call `:5015`). `index.ts` does not export it.
- No branch or open PR deletes it. The other `claude/issue-15204-*` heads are s1, s3 and s6c-prep. Of these, only s6c-prep touches the module, and only to repoint one import (`per-organization-catalog` to `organization-scope`, 2 lines). Whichever of the two PRs lands second gets a modify/delete conflict on this file, and the fix is to keep the deletion.
- After 6b-1a (#22669), the nine curated names resolve in the registry. This was measured on a booted showcase (below), and `builtin-capabilities.boot.test.ts` asserts it.

## Who reads `sys_capability` rows (re-measured on this tree)

| reader | what it is | fresh database after this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Setup nav `nav_capabilities` (`security-plugin.ts:1612`) and the object's list page | a UI listing of rows | lists only the package rows (showcase: 2, was 11). Correction 3 holds this PR behind C9, whose picker reads the registry |
| `sys-capability.object.ts` lookup providers (`:122`, `:132`, `:142`) | the picker data source | same rows as above |
| the curated-name row gate (`security-plugin.ts` `:7652`–`:7710`, stage 8-pre) | refuses a Setup row claiming a curated name | unchanged. It reads `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_NAMES`, not the seeded rows; it reads a row only to detect a rename |
| `cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts:349` | an ownership census of the table | counts fewer platform rows; no decision rides on it |
| `lint/src/validate-capability-references.ts:97` | reads a stack's `data` seed declarations, not rows | unchanged |

No runtime authorization path reads a row: grants resolve by the name in `systemPermissions` (`core/src/security`, `rest`, `objectql`, `services` grep: zero `sys_capability` reads).

## Measured fresh-database effect (showcase, `pnpm dev -- --fresh`, this branch, all three reads as `admin@objectos.ai`)

| reading | before (`main`, from the 6b-1a report 6096357309 and the boot pin's old census) | after (this branch, measured) |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `GET /api/v1/data/sys_capability` (the Setup capability list) | 11 rows: 9 curated `platform` + 2 `package` | **2 rows**: `showcase.export_data`, `showcase.restricted_ops`, both `managed_by: package` |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/capability` | 11 | 11 (the nine curated names plus the two package names) |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/capability/manage_users` | 200 | 200 |
| capability refusal or failure lines in the boot log | 0 | 0 |

The derived half adds nothing: the 6b-1a report measured that every `systemPermissions` entry of the platform's default sets is curated, and the showcase's one non-curated grant (`showcase.export_data`) is its own declared capability.

## Changes

- **Deleted:** `bootstrap-system-capabilities.ts` (995) and `bootstrap-system-capabilities.test.ts` (1,376).
- **`security-plugin.ts`:** removed the import, the `bootstrapSystemCapabilities` try block, and the `materializedCapabilityNames` handoff. That variable existed only to feed the deleted call, and under `noUnusedLocals` it cannot stay. The `bootstrapDeclaredCapabilities` call, its arguments and the `withoutPlatformCapabilityDeclarations` view are unchanged; only its `const capOutcome =` binding goes. Two comments that would now be false are reworded: the seeding block and the curated-name gate's doc.
- **Tests, each one classified:**
  - `bootstrap-seed-round-trips.test.ts`: the `#11451/#11520` describe asserts the seeder's own round trips, so its eight seeder cases go. One case (`the existing callers still emit their exact key set`) only calls `bootstrapDeclaredPermissions` and fences `buildExistingByName`. It is kept, in a describe of its own.
  - `bootstrap-declared-capabilities.test.ts` (measured here; not in the amendment's list): `CLAIMS a derived … placeholder` used the seeder only to set up a `platform` row, so it now inserts that row directly. `declared name suppresses the implicit derived placeholder`, and eight `#4967 Part 1` cases, assert how the two seeders combine, so they go. `materializedNames reconciles with the outcome counters` stays. The whole file goes in 6b-1c.
  - `builtin-capabilities.boot.test.ts` (measured here; 6b-1a's pin): its census expected the nine curated rows. It now expects only the stack's package row, on a fresh database and on a re-opened one, with zero writes on the second boot. This is the stage's acceptance pin.
  - `seed-name-lookup-degradation-audible.test.ts`, `bootstrap-platform-admin-seeded-provenance.test.ts`, `sys-capability.organization-unique.test.ts`, `driver-sql/…/sql-driver-declared-index-organization-respelling.test.ts`: each named the seeder in a comment only. The sentence that would now be false is reworded or dropped. No assertion changes.
- **Comments in surviving modules that would now be false:** `builtin-capabilities.ts` (item 2 of its header), `spec/src/security/capabilities.ts` (its consumer list; doc comment only, no schema or export change), `lint/src/validate-capability-references.ts` (the "mirrors bootstrapSystemCapabilities" clause).
- **Censuses, each regenerated by its own tool:** `scripts/engine-double-contract.baseline.json` loses the deleted test's row. `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write` re-counted the write call sites (241 → 239, two erased-receiver sites gone). The hand-written prose counts on `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` are corrected to match, as the gate requires.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/15204-s6b1b-system-capability-seeder.md`, `@objectstack/plugin-security` minor.

## Verification

- Build: `--filter '@objectstack/plugin-security...'`, `lint...`, `driver-sql...`, `dogfood^...`, `runtime...`, plus the packages `dual-build-cjs-loads` needed: all exit 0.
- `plugin-security`: `typecheck` exit 0 (tsc, scripts, and `check:test-typecheck`, which covers the tests); `vitest run`: **197 files, 4055 passed / 45 skipped**, at `b88b3567`. The later commit `264e056d` touched only the two census docs.
- `lint`: 135 files, 6231 passed; typecheck exit 0. `driver-sql`: the edited file passed 26 tests; typecheck exit 0. `runtime`: `standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy` passed 13 tests.
- Dogfood pins that read capabilities: `security-catalog-showcase`, `audit-log-audit-capability`, `showcase-d3-d4-capabilities`, `me-apps-and-everyone-baseline` and `org-admin-affordance-reach`: 5 files, 69 passed.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 121 commands. `--ran` reconciles **121 derived, 121 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**. The first pass of four commands needed work before they passed:
  - `check-tenant-audit-census` and its self-test went red on this diff's real count change, and were fixed above.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed an unshallowed clone.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed 8 packages built outside the closure.
- **Line budget:** 2,930 changed lines (+83 / −2,847, 17 files), under 3,000.

## Acceptance notes

- `sys-capability.object.ts:87` still says "The two production readers of the table are both seeders (`bootstrap-system-capabilities.ts`, `bootstrap-declared-capabilities.ts`)". The amendment excludes any change to that file, so it waits for stage 8, which retires the object. Carrier: stage 8.
- The 6b-1a ACCEPT (6096401008) records the transitional view's deletion as owed by "6b-1b … together with the seeders". The later amendment 6098440046 moves it to 6b-1c, and the dispatch says not to touch it. This PR follows the amendment.
- On a database that was already seeded, the curated `platform` rows stay (no row is deleted). They are no longer refreshed at boot, and stage 8 / C7b retire them.
